                    ### Question
                    Which of the following associations is correct ?:

                    ### Options
                    opa. Rickettsia prowazekii / ehrlichiosis.
opb. Coxiella burnetti / fever Q.
opc. Rickettsia rickettsii / Lyme disease.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Rickettsia prowazekii is correctly associated with epidemic typhus, not ehrlichiosis. Coxiella burnetii is correctly linked to Q fever. Rickettsia rickettsii causes Rocky Mountain spotted fever, not Lyme disease. Borrelia burgdorferi is correctly associated with Lyme disease, not typhus. The evidence paths support these associations by confirming the diseases caused by each pathogen.
